facts.text: Sam has become a Weight Watchers coach in their group, which they describe as a significant accomplishment.

evidence.quote: I'm a Weight Watchers coach in my group now! It's a pretty big accomplishment for me, feel really proud.
Becoming a Weight Watchers coach is a big deal.

facts.text: Sam expresses gratitude towards Evan for his support and acknowledges the progress they have made in their health journey.

evidence.quote: Thanks, Evan! Appreciate your support. It's been a journey, and being chosen as a coach is a great step in my quest for better health.
You've come such a long way. It's exciting to see what comes next for you in your quest for better health.

facts.text: Sam believes that being a coach will help them stay motivated and assist others in staying committed to their health goals.

evidence.quote: Being a coach will hopefully keep me motivated and help others stay committed too.

facts.text: Evan acknowledges Sam's achievements and expresses admiration for their ability to inspire others through their role as a coach.

evidence.quote: Helping others stay committed and motivated is so rewarding. You really inspire us.
